title: High, in Yonder Realms of Light
description: High, in Yonder Realms of Light in Tonic Solfa to HEINLEIN, doh is F: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 3 verses and a piano.
about: Thomas Raffles wrote these words. They were printed in Hymns for Christian Devotion, compiled by John G. Adams and Edwin H. Chapin (Boston, 1846), as hymn 562 of its twenty-second edition (1853), “The Saints in Glory”.
The book printed the words without tunes, marked Sevens (7.7.7.7), to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to HEINLEIN; any other Sevens tune fits them as well.
underlay: High, in yon-der realms of light, Dwell the rap-tured saints a-bove, Far be-yond our fee-ble sight, Hap-py in Im-man-uel's love.

lines: High, in yonder realms of light,
Where no grief can entrance find,
Lulled to rest the aching head,
Soothed the anguish of the mind.
Songs of praise to Jesus' love.

licence: Public domain: Thomas Raffles died in 1863.
credits: Words by Thomas Raffles (1788–1863), public domain, as printed in Hymns for Christian Devotion (1853); set to HEINLEIN by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
